archive_policy: Verify whole archive SHA256 before reading any member. Select only the specified regular file; reject links and duplicate members. Keep upstream notices. Downloads occur only during explicit kit preparation.
provenance_limits: Slither 538 and crytic-compile 41 Python source files in the wheels matched their catalog revisions.
The historical OWNED socket-filter profile is not modified or re-certified by this separately pinned profile.
ABI, AST and bytecode comparison uses the same solc through two separate compiler interfaces.
steps: Create an empty private kit directory at a caller-chosen path.
Download the pinned solc image into kit/solc and verify its hash before marking it executable.
Download all 51 wheels using slither-native-pins.json URL/filename/SHA256 entries. Keep each wheel unchanged. No pip resolver or installation hooks are needed.

Verify the Debian package SHA256, read its data.tar.xz ar member, then select the exact regular libseccomp tar member and verify its hash. Copy it to kit/libseccomp.so.2 and retain upstream copyright notices from the package.

The runner extracts each wheel into a separate distribution directory, verifies the visible metadata index, stages the libseccomp bytes into sealed memfd storage, and tests four denied socket types before importing Slither.
